notes:
• Restarting the timer on a ticket now carries on from the time you already had, so no part of it gets lost.
• Choosing Close on save right after booking time now closes the ticket.
• On clients with more than one contract, Book time waits until the contracts have loaded, so time can't go out without one.
• With Set times on, the line under Book time now matches the hours shown beside the time boxes.
• When something can't load, like Internal time's codes or a search, the app now says so and offers Try again.
• Lists keep their place when you open a ticket beside them.
• Editing an entry in My time closes the editor right away, and the total catches up a moment later.
• A ticket in its own window and the main window now stay in step when you book time or change the status.
• At large text sizes the ticket page moves to one column, so nothing is cut off at the right edge.
• For managers: Marking a PO line received in Quoting changes just that line, with no full reload.
• Easter eggs!
